binding_rules: UNKNOWN on any axis propagates to risk as UNKNOWN, never NONE or independent
an INVISIBLE authority supported only by CROSS_ENGINE_DERIVED evidence is NOT independently evidenced
no evidence mechanism may support a claim until its ability to distinguish success from failure has been demonstrated

a SURVIVED mutation is not evidence of shared fate or of a missing control until target reachability has been demonstrated; if mutated and unmutated behaviour agree unexpectedly, challenge the measuring path before classifying the authority (AC4: F2, F3, F5, F6 each depended on this, and the namespace campaign exposed a --no-fail-fast instrumentation defect)
